source_text: The World Health Organization (WHO) and Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS) recommend voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) as part of HIV prevention strategies in regions with high heterosexual transmission prevalence, citing evidence from three randomized controlled trials demonstrating efficacy.
